questions.question: Which portal-entry rule applies to an authenticated SC user with no registered application entity entitlement?

options.label: A. Deny entry
options.description: Require at least one entitlement for an application entity registered in the portal.

options.label: B. Allow entry
options.description: Permit portal entry. Apply separate permission checks to tile visibility.

options.label: Obtain owner confirmation
options.description: Keep the question unresolved. Identify the policy owner or obtain an applicable policy record before selecting a rule.

content.content: Your questions have been answered: "Which portal-entry rule applies to an authenticated SC user with no registered application entity entitlement?"="A. Deny entry". You can now continue with these answers in mind.

questions.question: Where should the selected portal-entry rule apply?

options.label: All portal environments
options.description: Require a registered application entity entitlement in local, test, UAT, and production environments.

options.label: UAT only
options.description: Apply this clarification to UAT. Leave other environments unresolved.

options.label: Scope not confirmed
options.description: Keep environment applicability unresolved until the responsible owner or an applicable policy source confirms it.

content.content: Your questions have been answered: "Where should the selected portal-entry rule apply?"="All portal environments". You can now continue with these answers in mind.

questions.question: What should the portal do when a tile has no configured EMS2 entity?

options.label: Deny tile access (Recommended)
options.description: Hide the tile and deny direct tile launch until an EMS2 entity is configured. This does not define application data permissions.

options.label: Allow eligible portal users
options.description: Treat the tile as available to users who already satisfy the portal-entry rule. Keep application data permissions separate.

options.label: Ask the policy owner
options.description: Keep this question unresolved until the responsible owner confirms the intended behavior.

content.content: Your questions have been answered: "What should the portal do when a tile has no configured EMS2 entity?"="Deny tile access (Recommended)". You can now continue with these answers in mind.
